input: Any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path or /turn/ply.num must be signed by that piece's own key and also co-signed by at least twelve different Black agents' keys from /team/pieces/, so no single agent, including knight_b8, can push an off-plan move alone.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/turn/ply.num) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false)
